id: title:Piccirello:add a flag to enforce the app policy on signed out auth pages

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a bounded, opt-in Content Security Policy (CSP) enforcement capability for signed-out pages while retaining existing app-policy enforcement, potentially improving security posture for authenticated and unauthenticated user contexts.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F2.H1 introduces a new CSP enforcement flag and its associated path matching and enforcement. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement in the security configuration of the application. The implementation retains existing enforcement, suggesting a conservative, additive change rather than a replacement. This warrants a score of 2.
review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and validation of the CSP enforcement and its interaction with the existing app-policy enforcement are not fully demonstrated in the provided hunk. The actual runtime behavior and potential edge cases are not verified. No release notes or adoption metrics are available to confirm the benefit or reach of this change.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No score is assigned; tier assignment requires a score, not an observation-only chunk.
